english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for the next event or item, whether temporal or sequential.
This is the all-purpose casual choice for what follows next in a sequence or on a subsequent occasion.
Use this when the following action happens next or when someone or something follows another.
Use this colloquial form when describing the next step in an ongoing sequence.

gan1 zyu6 ngo5 dei6 zau6 heoi3 sik6 faan6

examples.english: We went in after lining up.

examples.english: We order first, and afterwards we wait for a table.
